decode_0bit_watermark: decode a 0-bit watermark from images using a hypercone direction, angle, and feature extraction model
decode_multibit_watermark: decode a multi-bit watermark message from images using K carrier directions and a feature model
run_0bit_detection: run 0-bit watermark detection on a list of PIL images and return acceptance function R and p-values
run_multibit_decoding: run multi-bit watermark decoding on a list of PIL images and return extracted boolean messages
review_decode_functions: review the decode_0bit and decode_multibit functions for watermark detection and message extraction logic
